profile.reading:
Meta broke ground on 11 February 2026 on a data center campus in the LEAP Research and Innovation District in Lebanon, Boone County, Indiana, about 29 miles northwest of downtown Indianapolis. Meta says the site is designed for 1 GW of capacity and represents an investment of more than $10 billion. It is Meta's second Indiana site after Jeffersonville.

The approved plan has 13 buildings, ten of them data center buildings, totalling about 4 million square feet. The campus sits in the southern part of the district, west of Interstate 65 and crossed by State Road 32. Meta expects the first buildings online by the end of 2027, with about 300 operating jobs.

Meta says it will pay the full cost of its energy and use a closed-loop liquid cooling system. City documents called the project Project Domino. No street address has been published, so the facility is not yet mapped.
